note: Maintained subsystem notes describe bounded development support. Partial never means a whole subsystem is complete. Shared framework rows do not certify every host backend.

areas.name: Java / DEX runtime
areas.notes: Standalone ART, threads, exceptions and reflection run real apps. Broad Java/API behavior remains incremental.

areas.name: Views, input and lifecycle
areas.notes: Onboarding, pointer input, text entry and resizing exercised. Complex layouts, animations and complete app flows still expose gaps.

areas.name: Resources and themes
areas.notes: APK resources, density/configuration changes and selected theme paths work; arbitrary attributes and full theme parity remain incomplete.

areas.name: Files and preferences
areas.notes: Synthetic committed preferences and queued apply writes survive separate OpenJDK/ART processes. Telegram saved-login persistence is still unverified.

areas.name: SQLite storage
areas.notes: SQLite-backed app state is used by tested apps; complete Android database APIs and every failure mode are not established.

areas.name: Networking and TLS
areas.notes: A historical targeted network run records 49 passes. Guest sockets and initial MTProto exchange tested; full current network suite remains unrun.

areas.name: Binder and Android services
areas.notes: Selected in-process/host IPC services exist. Full Android service behavior and cross-process compatibility are not established.

areas.name: Canvas, EGL and GLES
areas.notes: Real apps render through software/host graphics paths. Rendering parity and all graphics APIs are not verified.

areas.name: Android native ELF / Bionic
areas.notes: Telegram library initialization and selected libc, socket, TLS and JNI bridges tested. This is not complete syscall or native-ABI compatibility.

areas.name: Audio playback and AAC
areas.notes: PCM output, WAV/AAC decode, AAC encode and timestamps tested with synthetic media. Telegram voice messages and calls remain unverified.

areas.name: Microphone and camera
areas.notes: Host bridges and foreground consent checks exist; physical capture in Telegram has not been verified. JPEG tests use synthetic pixels.

areas.name: Video recording
areas.notes: The macOS video-recording pipeline is not implemented. Audio-only recording APIs do not imply video support.

areas.name: Android sensors
areas.notes: No Android sensor event bridge is advertised on Darwin.

areas.name: Remote media / casting
areas.notes: Only a local default audio route is provided. Remote and cast routing are unavailable.

areas.name: WebView JavaScript / DOM
areas.notes: The current WebView subset does not supply a JavaScript/DOM engine; rich editing and arbitrary web content are not supported.

areas.name: Google Play services runtime
areas.notes: Shiraz does not provide the Google Play Store or Google Play system services. Bundled client libraries do not supply those services.

areas.name: Cellular telephony and SMS
areas.notes: No claim of real modem control, phone calls or carrier SMS compatibility. App login over the network is a separate flow.

areas.name: Android platform certification
areas.notes: No complete CTS/VTS run, complete API behavior result or whole-platform compatibility percentage is established.
